description: JRC-IDEES: Integrierte Datenbank des europäischen Energiesystems (EU27 und Mitgliedstaaten, 2000-2021). Die Excel-Blätter wurden in 604 Tabellen je Sektor geladen (Zeile = Jahr und Land, Spalte = Energieträger/Kennzahl). Dieses Dashboard nutzt die Energie- und Emissionsbilanzen (energybalance_*, emissionbalance_*) und die Stromerzeugungsübersicht (powergen_*). Energie in ktoe wird in TWh umgerechnet (1 ktoe = 0,01163 TWh), Emissionen in kt CO2 in Mt.

panels.title: Tabellen
panels.description: Anzahl Tabellen im Schema jrc_idees (je Excel-Blatt eine, plus Marker crawl_complete).

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as n from pg_tables where schemaname='jrc_idees'

panels.title: Länder
panels.description: Mitgliedstaaten plus EU27-Summe in den Energiebilanzen.

targets.rawSql: select count(distinct zone) as n from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_e

panels.title: Zeitraum
panels.description: Erstes und letztes Jahr der Energiebilanz.

targets.rawSql: select min(extract(year from year))::int::text || ' - ' || max(extract(year from year))::int::text as zeitraum from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_e

panels.title: Endenergieverbrauch
panels.description: Endenergieverbrauch des gewählten Landes im gewählten Jahr (Energiebilanz fc_e).

targets.rawSql: select "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as twh from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_e where zone='$zone' and extract(year from year)=$year

panels.title: Strom-Anteil
panels.description: Anteil von Strom am Endenergieverbrauch.

targets.rawSql: select 100*"Electricity_E7000"/"Total_TOTAL" as p from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_e where zone='$zone' and extract(year from year)=$year

panels.title: CO2 Endverbrauch
panels.description: CO2-Emissionen aus dem Endenergieverbrauch (ohne Umwandlungssektor) des gewählten Landes und Jahres.

targets.rawSql: select "Total_TOTAL"/1000 as mt from jrc_idees.emissionbalance_fc_e where zone='$zone' and extract(year from year)=$year

panels.title: Endenergieverbrauch nach Sektor
panels.description: Endenergieverbrauch des gewählten Landes in TWh je Sektor (Energiebilanz fc_ind/tra/oth).

targets.rawSql: select year as time, 'Industrie' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_ind_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Verkehr' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_tra_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Haushalte' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_hh_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Dienstleistungen' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_cp_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Landwirtschaft/Forst/Fischerei' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_aff_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year)

panels.title: Energieträgermix im gewählten Sektor
panels.description: Endenergieverbrauch nach Energieträger in TWh. Sektor über die Variable wählbar.

targets.rawSql:
select year as time, "Solid fossil fuels_C0000X0350-0370"*0.01163 as "Feste fossile Brennstoffe", "Oil and petroleum products_O4000XBIO"*0.01163 as "Öl und Ölprodukte",
"Natural gas_G3000"*0.01163 as "Erdgas", "Renewables and biofuels_RA000"*0.01163 as "Erneuerbare und Biokraftstoffe", "Non-renewable waste_W6100_6220"*0.01163 as "Nicht erneuerbarer Abfall",
"Heat_H8000"*0.01163 as "Fernwärme", "Electricity_E7000"*0.01163 as "Strom"
from jrc_idees.energybalance_$sector where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) order by 1

panels.title: Strom-Anteil am Endenergieverbrauch
panels.description: Anteil von Strom am Endenergieverbrauch je Land im gewählten Jahr (Elektrifizierungsgrad).

targets.rawSql: select zone as land, 100*"Electricity_E7000"/"Total_TOTAL" as "Strom-Anteil" from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_e where extract(year from year)=$year and zone <> 'EU27' order by 2 desc

panels.title: Endenergieverbrauch pro Einwohner
panels.description: Endenergieverbrauch in MWh pro Einwohner im gewählten Jahr (Einwohner aus residential_res_summary).

targets.rawSql:
select e.zone as land, e."Total_TOTAL"*0.01163*1e6/r."Population (inhabitants)" as "MWh/Einwohner" from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_e e
join jrc_idees.residential_res_summary r on r.zone = e.zone and r.year = e.year where extract(year from e.year)=$year and e.zone <> 'EU27' order by 2 desc

panels.title: Endenergieverbrauch der Länder
panels.description: Endenergieverbrauch in TWh im gewählten Jahr.

targets.rawSql: select zone as land, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as "TWh" from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_e where extract(year from year)=$year and zone <> 'EU27' order by 2 desc

panels.title: Industrie nach Branche
panels.description: Endenergieverbrauch der Industrie in TWh nach Branche.

targets.rawSql: select year as time, 'Eisen und Stahl' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_ind_is_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Chemie' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_ind_cpc_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Nichteisenmetalle' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_ind_nfm_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Steine und Erden' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_ind_nmm_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Papier und Druck' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_ind_ppp_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Nahrungsmittel' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_ind_fbt_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Fahrzeugbau' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_ind_te_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Maschinenbau' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_ind_mac_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Bergbau' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_ind_mq_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Holz' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_ind_wp_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Textil und Leder' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_ind_tl_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Sonstige Industrie' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_ind_nsp_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year)

panels.title: Verkehr nach Verkehrsträger
panels.description: Endenergieverbrauch des Verkehrs in TWh (ohne internationalen Luft- und Seeverkehr).

targets.rawSql: select year as time, 'Straße' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_tra_road_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Schiene' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_tra_rail_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Inlandsflug' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_tra_davi_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Binnen- und Küstenschifffahrt' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_tra_dnavi_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Pipelines' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_tra_pipe_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year)

panels.title: Haushalte nach Verwendungszweck
panels.description: Endenergieverbrauch der Haushalte in TWh nach Anwendung.

targets.rawSql: select year as time, 'Raumwärme' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_hh_sh_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Warmwasser' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_hh_wh_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Kochen' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_hh_co_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Beleuchtung' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_hh_li_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Kühlen und Gefrieren' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_hh_rf_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Geschirrspüler' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_hh_dw_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Waschmaschinen' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_hh_wm_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Trockner' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_hh_dr_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Fernseher' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_hh_tv_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Raumkühlung' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_hh_sc_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Sonstige Geräte' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"*0.01163 as v from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_hh_oa_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year)

panels.title: Haushalte: Verbrauch pro Haushalt und Gradtage
panels.description: Endenergieverbrauch pro Haushalt in MWh (linke Achse) und tatsächliche Heizgradtage (rechte Achse). Kalte Jahre treiben den Verbrauch.

targets.rawSql:
select e.year as time, e."Total_TOTAL"*0.01163*1e6/r."Number of households" as "MWh pro Haushalt", r."Actual heating degree-days" as "Heizgradtage"
from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_oth_hh_e e join jrc_idees.residential_res_summary r on r.zone=e.zone and r.year=e.year where e.zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(e.year) order by 1

panels.title: CO2-Emissionen des Endverbrauchs nach Sektor
panels.description: Direkte CO2-Emissionen aus dem Endenergieverbrauch in Mt CO2 (ohne Umwandlungssektor; Strom- und Fernwärmeerzeugung erscheinen im Stromteil unten).

targets.rawSql: select year as time, 'Industrie' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"/1000 as v from jrc_idees.emissionbalance_fc_ind_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Verkehr' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"/1000 as v from jrc_idees.emissionbalance_fc_tra_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Haushalte' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"/1000 as v from jrc_idees.emissionbalance_fc_oth_hh_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Dienstleistungen' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"/1000 as v from jrc_idees.emissionbalance_fc_oth_cp_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) union all select year as time, 'Landwirtschaft/Forst/Fischerei' as metric, "Total_TOTAL"/1000 as v from jrc_idees.emissionbalance_fc_oth_aff_e where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year)

panels.title: CO2-Emissionen des Endverbrauchs der Länder
panels.description: Direkte CO2-Emissionen aus dem Endenergieverbrauch im gewählten Jahr in Mt.

targets.rawSql: select zone as land, "Total_TOTAL"/1000 as "Mt CO2" from jrc_idees.emissionbalance_fc_e where extract(year from year)=$year and zone <> 'EU27' order by 2 desc

panels.title: Installierte Kraftwerksleistung
panels.description: Brutto-Kraftwerkskapazität in GW nach Technologie (powergen_overviewpg).

targets.rawSql:
select year as time, "Nuclear"/1000 as "Kernenergie", "Conventional thermal"/1000 as "Konventionell thermisch", "Wind"/1000 as "Wind",
"Solar photovoltaics"/1000 as "Photovoltaik", "Solar thermal"/1000 as "Solarthermie", "Geothermal"/1000 as "Geothermie", "Hydro"/1000 as "Wasserkraft",
"Pumped storage"/1000 as "Pumpspeicher" from jrc_idees.powergen_overviewpg where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) order by 1

panels.title: Thermische Kraftwerke nach Brennstoff
panels.description: Brutto-Leistung konventioneller und Biomasse-Kraftwerke in GW nach Brennstoff (powergen_thermal).

targets.rawSql:
select year as time, "Coal"/1000 as "Steinkohle", "Lignite"/1000 as "Braunkohle", "Natural gas"/1000 as "Erdgas", "Biogas"/1000 as "Biogas", "Derived gas"/1000 as "Gichtgas u.ä.",
"Diesel oil"/1000 as "Diesel", "Fuel oil"/1000 as "Schweröl", "Solid biomass"/1000 as "Feste Biomasse", "Waste"/1000 as "Abfall" from jrc_idees.powergen_thermal where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) order by 1

panels.title: Stromerzeugung und CO2-Intensität
panels.description: Brutto-Stromerzeugung (ohne Pumpspeicher) in TWh und CO2-Intensität der Erzeugung in g CO2 pro kWh (CO2 der Stromerzeugung / Erzeugung).

targets.rawSql:
select year as time, "Total gross electricity prod. (without pumped storage) (GWh)"/1000 as "Bruttoerzeugung",
"CO2 emissions  (kt CO2)"*1000.0/nullif("Total gross electricity prod. (without pumped storage) (GWh)",0) as "CO2-Intensität"
from jrc_idees.powergen_overviewpg where zone='$zone' and $__timeFilter(year) order by 1

panels.title: Wind- und Solaranteil an der Kraftwerksleistung
panels.description: Anteil von Wind plus Photovoltaik an der installierten Brutto-Leistung je Land im gewählten Jahr.

targets.rawSql: select zone as land, 100*("Wind"+"Solar photovoltaics")/nullif("Total gross capacities (MW)",0) as "Wind+PV-Anteil" from jrc_idees.powergen_overviewpg where extract(year from year)=$year and zone <> 'EU27' order by 2 desc

list.name: zone
list.label: Land
list.description: Länderkürzel nach Eurostat (EL = Griechenland), EU27 = Summe der Mitgliedstaaten.
list.definition: select distinct zone from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_e order by 1

query.rawSql: select distinct zone from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_e order by 1

list.name: year
list.label: Jahr (Ländervergleiche)
list.definition: select distinct extract(year from year)::int::text from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_e order by 1 desc

query.rawSql: select distinct extract(year from year)::int::text from jrc_idees.energybalance_fc_e order by 1 desc

list.name: sector
list.label: Sektor (Energieträgermix)
list.query: Gesamt : fc_e,Industrie : fc_ind_e,Verkehr : fc_tra_e,Haushalte : fc_oth_hh_e,Dienstleistungen : fc_oth_cp_e,Landwirtschaft/Forst/Fischerei : fc_oth_aff_e
